name: sway-trace-mode-tage-update-diag
title: Diagnose why TAGE update path is silent in trace mode
creator: glr
notes: Resolved 2026-06-16. The latest three trace-fix commits were ruled out by older ancestor evidence. Phase-1 counters showed trace mode reaches resolved update and BTBTAGE::update, but all update entries were filtered because resolved conditional entries stayed alwaysTaken. Deeper root cause: trace decode/IEW squash paths passed predicted taken as branchTaken instead of traceBranchTaken, so predicted-taken/actual-not-taken trace branches were recorded as hit-taken and never cleared MBTB alwaysTaken. Fix uses traceBranchTaken() as actual outcome in Decode::selfSquash and IEW::squashDueToBranch when trace branch metadata exists; BTBTAGE keeps the normal !alwaysTaken filter. Follow-up audit fixed similar trace metadata gaps: Decode::selfSquash now redirects to traceBranchNextPC, Commit no longer re-overrides trace branchTaken for static uncond branches, trace branch type now feeds DynInst/BranchInfo/CommitTrace classification, and ChampSim taken branches now carry an estimated mapped target. Audit cbp2025/int_0 500K smoke: mbtb.condHitNotTakens=4, tage.updateFilteredEntries=192, updateMispred=3, updateAllocSuccess=3. Audit CPT blender/26411 500K smoke stayed unchanged at updateFilteredEntries=60158, updateMispred=2835, updateAllocSuccess=2810.
